quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (filed 08-14-2026, consolidated, K-IFRS): Q2 2026 (04-01-2026 to 06-30-2026) revenue KRW 79,318,746M, +50.9% QoQ (Q1: KRW 52,576,287M) and +256.8% YoY (Q2 2025: KRW 22,231,952M), a record for the second consecutive quarter; Q2 operating profit KRW 60,542,608M (+61.0% QoQ, +557.2% YoY), operating margin 76%; Q2 net profit KRW 93,922,593M (+132.8% QoQ, +1,242.5% YoY) lifted by KRW 65,858,814M of financial income (KRW 53,237,425M valuation gain on financial instruments, largely the Kioxia-linked stake, plus KRW 10,027,945M dividend income). H1 2026: revenue KRW 131,895,033M, operating profit KRW 98,152,891M, net profit KRW 134,268,502M, basic EPS KRW 189,546. Mix Q2: DRAM KRW 56,982,743M (72%), NAND Flash KRW 21,959,898M (28%), other KRW 376,105M; H1 DRAM KRW 97,641,379M / NAND KRW 33,534,133M. Q2 DRAM shipments up slightly on HBM3E and AI server DRAM, DRAM ASP up mid-30% QoQ on continued commodity DRAM price strength; NAND shipments up mid-10% QoQ (Q1 base effect plus enterprise SSD expansion), NAND ASP up mid-50% QoQ across all products. Geography H1: US KRW 84,564,776M (64%), China KRW 32,478,276M (25%), Asia ex-China KRW 11,387,227M, Europe KRW 2,804,146M, Korea KRW 660,608M; more than 90% of sales are USD-denominated. Market share Q1 2026 (IDC): DRAM 29.1%, NAND 18.5%. Balance sheet 2026-06-30: cash, short-term financial instruments and short-term investments KRW 87,957,923M vs borrowings KRW 18,586,634M (net cash), debt-to-equity 32.8%, equity KRW 262,693,228M; H1 operating cash flow KRW 91,742,501M.

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026): supply volumes and prices are agreed with major customers monthly/quarterly; there is no order backlog under long-term supply contracts. Customer concentration H1 2026 (consolidated): two unnamed customers each exceeded 10% of revenue - customer A KRW 17,608,702M (13.35%) and customer B KRW 17,187,421M (13.03%); in H1 2025 a single customer A accounted for KRW 10,890,639M (27.31%), so the top-customer share halved as the base broadened. Trade receivables rose to KRW 47,821,395M at 2026-06-30 from KRW 18,199,078M at 2025-12-31, all aged 6 months or less. Sales subsidiary revenue H1 2026: SK hynix America Inc. KRW 75,475,832M (vs KRW 24,749,336M in H1 2025), SK hynix (Wuxi) Semiconductor Sales KRW 28,298,568M, SK hynix Semiconductor Taiwan KRW 5,067,670M, SK hynix Asia (Singapore) KRW 4,482,466M; NAND Product Solutions (Solidigm) group H1 revenue KRW 12,250,694M, net profit KRW 5,839,588M (vs KRW 3,355,653M / KRW 132,068M). DRAM is sold to global mobile and computing OEMs; NAND to mobile-device and IT OEMs, SSD and memory-card makers.
quarterly_data.figure: No long-term-contract backlog; two customers >10% of H1 revenue: KRW 17,608,702M (13.35%) and KRW 17,187,421M (13.03%)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026): H1 2026 production and capacity both KRW 24,152,765M at cost with average fab utilisation 100% (136,255,098 available hours fully used, 181 operating days, 4-crew 3-shift); the filing attributes Q2 price rises to strong AI-infrastructure demand against a constrained supply environment. Capex: H1 2026 property, plant and equipment acquisitions KRW 17,595,043M (H1 2025: KRW 11,249,168M), including KRW 6,052,326M of machinery and KRW 10,584,315M of construction in progress; PP&E net book value KRW 88,889,146M with construction in progress KRW 20,830,993M at 2026-06-30. Unrecorded purchase commitments for PP&E jumped to KRW 61,484,533M at 2026-06-30 from KRW 6,667,863M at 2025-12-31. Board approved Yongin Cluster fab 1 Phase 2-6 construction on 2026-02-25 (Yongin Y1 phase 1 fab already under construction); on 2026-04-22 disclosed the Cheongju P&T7 advanced-packaging-only fab, groundbreaking April 2026, about KRW 19 trillion; on 2026-06-29 disclosed a mid-to-long-term investment plan: Yongin cluster about KRW 600 trillion (4th fab completed by 2033, then phased equipment), Cheongju about KRW 100 trillion (new fab, equipment, HBM back-end advanced packaging), and a new south-west Korea cluster about KRW 400 trillion (site, fabs, equipment in stages). The Indiana (West Lafayette) fab project progress was reported to the board 2026-06-24; SK hynix Semiconductor West Lafayette LLC carries a USD 1,028M parent guarantee for US Department of Commerce DFA performance and loan repayment. Cheongju M15X clean room opened October 2025. Fluorine-gas passivation fires on 06-01-2026 (M15, 6F) and 06-12-2026 (M15X, 2F) drew equipment shutdown orders from the Geum River environmental office and a Ministry of Employment and Labor work-stoppage recommendation for F2 passivation at Cheongju after 5 accidents in 2026; damaged fab boxes to be removed and re-inspected. Raw-material inputs H1: wafers KRW 999,418M (9%), substrates KRW 287,585M (3%), PCB KRW 156,983M (1%), other materials KRW 5,588,736M, spares/sub-materials KRW 3,936,882M, total KRW 10,969,605M; 300mm wafers from major suppliers with fabs in Japan, Korea, Germany and the US; substrates from 9 suppliers in Korea, Japan and China; PCBs from 6 suppliers in Korea and Greater China with production shifting to South-East Asia. Related-party purchases H1 2026 (consolidated): SK Siltron KRW 244,669M (wafers), SK Specialty KRW 29,848M, SK Trichem KRW 83,339M, SK Enpulse KRW 3,124M, SK Airplus KRW 3,924M; asset acquisitions from SK Ecoplant KRW 2,439,375M (fab construction). Back-end packaging, package test and module services are bought from the 45%-owned Wuxi JV HITECH Semiconductor under a contract with priority equipment rights and guaranteed minimum revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: Utilisation 100% (H1 2026); H1 capex KRW 17,595,043M; PP&E purchase commitments KRW 61,484,533M; mid-to-long-term plan ~KRW 1,100 trillion (Yongin ~600T, Cheongju ~100T, south-west cluster ~400T, disclosed 06-29-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026): Nasdaq listing - 177,900,000 ADRs (10 ADRs per share) representing 17,790,000 new common shares listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on 07-10-2026 at USD 1,490 per 10 ADRs, gross proceeds USD 26,507,100,000 (KRW 39,890,534,790,000 at 1,504.90 on payment date 07-14-2026), use of proceeds: facility investment; the new shares were listed on KRX on 07-29-2026 (board approval 06-24-2026; confidential SEC registration statement filed 03-24-2026). Product pipeline in 2026: HBM4E 12-high samples shipped June 2026; iHBM memory solution with integrated cooling inside the HBM package unveiled May 2026; 192GB SOCAMM2 on 1c (10nm 6th-gen) in mass production April 2026; HBF (High Bandwidth Flash) global standardisation strategy announced with Sandisk February 2026; 1c 16Gb LPDDR6 (10.7Gbps, +33% bandwidth, -20% power) for 2027 mobile flagships; 1c 16Gb DDR5 2nd-gen at 8,800-9,200Mbps for RDIMM/MRDIMM; PCIe Gen5 data-center SSD with direct liquid cooling for a US CSP and a 321-layer client PCIe Gen5 SSD developed; AIN family of AI-NAND (AIN P performance / AIN B bandwidth HBF) being built with Solidigm for QLC eSSD. H1 R&D spend KRW 6,042,871M (4.6% of revenue). Corporate: Moody's upgraded SK Hynix to A3 from Baa1 on 08-03-2026 (S&P BBB+ 02-05-2026, Fitch BBB+ 04-30-2026, domestic AA+); USD 1.7B 2023 exchangeable bond fully exchanged into 20,560,302 shares during H1 2026; 15,300,000 treasury shares cancelled 02-09-2026 (KRW 872,236,935,000); KRW 4,083,635M of capital reserves transferred to retained earnings (AGM 03-25-2026); Q2 dividend KRW 375/share (KRW 273.3B) declared 08-07-2026, record date 08-31-2026, under the 2025-2027 policy of fixed KRW 1,500/share annually; additional buyback/cancellation measures to be finalised within 2026. SK hynix NAND Product Solutions Corp. transferred its NAND/SSD sales and R&D business to newly formed Solidigm Inc. (established January 2026); Dalian FabCo/OpCo merged effective 07-01-2026; formation of a US AI company reported to the board 06-24-2026. Independent director Koh Seung-beom elected board chair 03-25-2026; Cha Seon-yong (head of Future Technology Research Institute) joined as inside director.
